rules.statement: The validity of a claim for housing is determined as of the time the Commissioner notifies the Minister and the Minister makes the vesting order.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) The relevant point of time at which the validity of the claim has to be determined is the stage at which the Commissioner of National Housing holds the Inquiry, 'Notifies' the Minister and the Minister makes the vesting order.
